label: Golden-hour rooftop — lifestyle / lookbook
note: Second campaign, proving the look is genuinely swappable — one --campaign flag re-shoots a whole set. Two heroes generated and reviewed on the Summer Daze tee: casting, set, wardrobe and grade all swapped cleanly and the chest print survived intact. Fan-outs and macros under this campaign are still unrun. The cream-garment-on-warm-concrete contrast risk did NOT materialise here because the low sun backlights the model and rim-lights the shoulders — but a front-lit variant of this campaign would be a real risk.
model_casting: young adult man, late-20s, medium-brown skin, short dark cropped hair with a close beard, relaxed easy expression
set: an open city rooftop at golden hour, warm pale concrete underfoot and a soft out-of-focus skyline behind
light: low warm late-afternoon sun raking from behind and to one side, long soft shadows, gentle lens flare, warm highlight rim on the shoulders
camera_full_body: full-body head-to-toe framing, model centred, eye-level, 50mm lens look, shallow depth so the skyline falls soft, small even margin above the head and below the shoes
camera_crop: Eye-level, 85mm, background falling well out of focus
grade: Photorealistic editorial lifestyle photography, warm golden grade
flatlay_light: Soft directional late-afternoon light, gentle shadow in the fabric folds.
accessories_rule: No jewellery, no bag, no other accessories.

wardrobe.top: a plain washed-black cotton crew tee
